FFmpeg n8.1, unmodified source https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n8.1
LGPL 2.1 or later. Minimal build: MOV/Matroska readers; MP4/Matroska/WebM writers; file protocol. VP9/AV1 parsers and decoders are present for metadata probing; no encoders, no network. Downloaded tracks are copied, never re-encoded.
Exact build command: scripts/build-ffmpeg-windows.sh in the accompanying source package. Corresponding FFmpeg source is included there.
